scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('web-dist/index.html')) { console.log('web-dist missing, building frontend assets...'); execSync('npm run build:web',{stdio:'inherit'}); } if(!fs.existsSync('web-dist/index.html')) { console.error('Missing web-dist/index.html after build:web'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Using frontend dist from apps/api/web-dist');"
scripts.build:web: node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); execSync('npm --workspace apps/web run build',{stdio:'inherit',cwd:'../..'});" && rm -rf web-dist && cp -R ../web/dist web-dist
